notes: The annual is the quarterly with more time and more strategic depth. It extends what the quarterlies built.
Day 1 tests the strategy and writes the new 3HAG. Day 2 builds the annual plan and the first quarter of it.
This is a working session. Protect time for the team to make decisions and capture its own plan.
The plan gives Day 1 about 405 working minutes, with no spare. Day 2 has about 340, which leaves about 65 for work carried over.
